page_title: CHE 3-0 LUT | Chelsea v Luton 25/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+2' Mason Burstow (Chelsea) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Raheem Sterling.
90+2' Wonderful movement by Chelsea. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Ian Maatsen (Chelsea) can count himself lucky for not being sent off after only receiving a caution from the referee.
89' A corner kick by Luton is thwarted by the well prepared Robert Sanchez (Chelsea).
88' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 8:1.
86' Mauricio Pochettino has decided to make a change. Ian Maatsen (Chelsea) replaces Ben Chilwell.

84' That didn't go as planned! Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Thomas Kaminski, who easily kept it out.
83' We are about to witness a subsitution. Chimuanya Ugochukwu (Chelsea) for Nicolas Jackson.
82' Ryan Giles (Luton) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
82' Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
81' Ryan Giles (Luton) sends a lofted pass into the penalty area from a free kick, but the opposition's defence manages to control all the attacking players and thwart the threat.
81' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) commits a rough challenge and Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul.

80' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Luton are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
78' Jacob Brown (Luton) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tahith Chong trots off the pitch and is replaced by Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton).
77' Rob Edwards decides to make a substitution. Ross Barkley will be replaced by Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton).
77' It is time for a substitution. Mads Juel Andersen (Luton) is on for Reece Burke.
75' 3 - 0 Goal! Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner.
74' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Luton, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
73' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
70' A substitution has been made. Elijah Adebayo goes off and Jacob Brown (Luton) comes on.
70' Rob Edwards prepares a substitution. Issa Kabore is replaced by Alfie Doughty (Luton).
68' 2 - 0 Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike, which goes inside the left post.
67' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
66' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
64' Ben Chilwell almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
62' The ball is cleared after Elijah Adebayo (Luton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

61' A sweet pass finds Ryan Giles (Luton) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. Robert Sanchez is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
58' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Robert Jones has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
58' One of the Chelsea players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
57' Luton concede a free kick following a bad challenge.

54' That was a nice football moment. Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the bottom left corner. Thomas Kaminski guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
53' Ryan Giles (Luton) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats well wide of the right post.
52' Chelsea fail to score from a corner as Thomas Kaminski (Luton) leaps to collect the ball.

51' That didn't go as planned. Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the left side of the goal was too weak to get past Thomas Kaminski, who easily kept it out.
51' Chelsea take a short corner kick.
51' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
49' Carlton Morris (Luton) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
48' It looks like Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) saw red with that tackle. Robert Jones won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
47' Chelsea are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Issa Kabore (Luton) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
41' Ryan Giles (Luton) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
41' Issa Kabore (Luton) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
41' Robert Jones blows his whistle and signals a foul after Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) brought his opponent down.
40' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
39' One of the Chelsea players was holding his opponent and the referee doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
38' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) chips a pass over the line of defenders to get the ball to Ben Chilwell, but his attempt is intercepted and cleared.

37' Chelsea slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
35' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
33' Issa Kabore (Luton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
32' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) commits a rough challenge and Robert Jones blows his whistle for an infringement.
31' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
30' Marvelous Nakamba (Luton) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
27' Tom Lockyer (Luton) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
27' Luton seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
25' Carlton Morris (Luton) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
24' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Chelsea is cautioned for aggressive play.
22' Ryan Giles (Luton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
21' A player from Chelsea commits a rough challenge. Robert Jones blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.

20' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Chelsea are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
17' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) unleashes a low shot into the left side of the goal after his wonderful individual effort.
15' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Luton.
15' A wild pass somehow finds Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.
14' One of the Luton players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
13' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) makes a rough challenge and Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul.
12' The percentage of ball possession is – 85:15.
10' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
9' Tahith Chong (Luton) dummies a defender then lets fly from the edge of the box, but the ball misses the left post by a mile.
7' A snap shot by Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) from mid-range towards the middle of the goal catches Thomas Kaminski flat footed, but he somehow recovers and makes a brilliant save.
5' The resulting set piece from Chelsea is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
5' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
4' Wonderful movement by Chelsea. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
3' Robert Jones interrupts the game. One of the players from Luton won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
2' Luton couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Robert Sanchez (Chelsea) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
2' Poor challenge! Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) is penalised for tripping and Robert Jones blows his whistle.
1' The first half has started.
